naam: Bal tegen de muur gooien – squat op een bosu
pose_en: She stands seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. A plain wall is directly IN FRONT of her (on the viewer's right), about one metre away. A BOSU balance trainer lies upside down on the floor: the round dome is DOWN on the floor and the flat platform faces UP, and she stands with both feet on the flat platform. She is in a half squat (knees bent about 60 degrees, hips back, back straight) and holds a ball with both hands against the middle of her chest. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at the ball and going FORWARD and UP toward the wall, showing the throw as she rises.
eind_en: END position: same side view, still standing on the flat platform of the upside-down BOSU. Her legs are straightened and both arms are stretched forward and slightly up toward the wall; the ball has just left her hands and flies toward the wall.
extra_avatar: The BOSU must clearly be UPSIDE DOWN (dome on the floor, flat platform on top, she stands on the flat side) and the wall is IN FRONT of her. TOP: half squat with the ball at her chest. BOTTOM: legs straight, arms reaching toward the wall, ball in the air between her hands and the wall.

naam: Voorwerpen herkennen op de tast – ogen dicht
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a plain chair at a table, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view, her back against the backrest. Her EYES ARE CLEARLY CLOSED. On the table in front of her stands an open box containing a few small everyday objects (a key, a coin, a comb, a toothbrush). Her right hand reaches into the box; her left hand rests on the table. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the right hand going DOWN into the box, showing her reaching in to pick up an object.
eind_en: END position: same view, eyes still closed. Her right hand holds a key just above the box, the fingers and thumb feeling around it; her left hand still rests on the table.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up. Her eyes are CLOSED in both figures (calm face, eyelids shut). TOP: right hand inside the open box of small objects. BOTTOM: right hand lifted just above the box holding a key between the fingers.

naam: Bovenrug strekken – buiklig met handen onder het voorhoofd
pose_en: She lies FACE DOWN (prone) on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. Her legs are straight. Her hands lie flat on the mat ON TOP OF EACH OTHER directly under her forehead, palms down, and her elbows are bent and point out to the sides, so her arms form a diamond shape on the mat; her forehead rests on the back of her hands. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the back of her head and upper chest going UP, showing the head and upper chest lifting.
eind_en: END position: same side view, still lying face down. Her forearms and hands stay pressed into the mat in the diamond shape, but her head and upper chest are lifted a few centimetres off the hands, chin slightly tucked, eyes looking down at the hands. Her lower body stays on the mat.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the waist up, lying face down, seen exactly from the side. Make the lift clearly visible but small: TOP forehead resting on the stacked hands, BOTTOM a clear gap between the forehead and the hands, upper chest off the mat, chin tucked - NOT a big back arch, the forearms stay flat on the mat.

naam: Elleboog buigen en strekken – ruglig met arm omhoog
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. Her knees may be slightly bent. Her right arm points STRAIGHT UP to the ceiling, the elbow fully straight, the hand open. Her LEFT hand holds her right upper arm just above the elbow to keep it still. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going DOWN toward her forehead, showing the elbow bending.
eind_en: END position: same side view, lying on her back. The right upper arm still points straight up (vertical) and is still held by her left hand, but the right elbow is now bent and the right hand is close to her forehead.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the waist up, lying on the back, seen from the side. Only ONE person (no helper). In BOTH figures the right UPPER arm is vertical. TOP: the whole right arm is straight up to the ceiling. BOTTOM: elbow bent about 120 degrees, right hand just above the forehead.

naam: Elleboog strekken over tafel – met handdoek
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a plain chair directly in front of a table, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. The table is IN FRONT of her (on the viewer's right). A folded towel lies flat on the tabletop. Her right forearm rests on the towel with the elbow bent and the hand close to her body. Her left hand rests on her lap. The arrow is a long straight arrow along the tabletop from her right hand pointing FORWARD, away from her body, showing the arm sliding forward on the towel.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her right arm has slid forward over the table on the towel until the elbow is completely straight; her trunk is still upright and does NOT lean forward.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up with the table clearly visible. Only the elbow moves: TOP elbow bent with the hand near her belly, BOTTOM arm straight forward on the towel. Her back stays upright in both figures - she does not lean over the table.

naam: Gevouwen handen kantelen – ellebogen op tafel
pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits at a table, seen from the FRONT. Both elbows rest on the table about shoulder-width apart and her forearms lean toward each other so they form a triangle (pyramid) with the hands at the top. Her fingers are interlaced firmly, the palms pressed together, and both wrists are bent back as far as comfortable. The joined hands are upright. The arrow is a curved arrow around the joined hands, turning toward the viewer's right like turning a large door knob, showing both forearms rotating together.
eind_en: END position: same front view, elbows still on the table, fingers still interlaced and palms still pressed together, but the joined hands have twisted to one side so the little-finger edge of her right hand faces toward her face.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the chest up, seen from the front, both elbows on the table. TOP: joined hands upright at the top of the forearm triangle. BOTTOM: the joined hands clearly twisted about 60 degrees to one side, the palms still pressed together - the elbows stay on the table.

naam: Hand plat op tafel voelen – met kijken
pose_en: Show only her forearms and hands on a tabletop, seen from above at a slight angle, and her face looking down at her hand at the top of the frame. Her right forearm and hand lie flat on the table, palm DOWN, wrist straight, fingers straight and slightly apart. The tip of her LEFT index finger presses lightly on the knuckle of her right index finger. The arrow is a short straight arrow along the right index finger, from the knuckle toward the fingertip, showing the left finger stroking along it.
eind_en: END position: same close view. The right hand still lies flat on the table, palm down; the left index finger has stroked along the right index finger and now presses lightly on its fingertip. She looks at her hand.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures close: forearms and hands on the table, her face looking down at the hand. TOP: left fingertip on the KNUCKLE of the right index finger. BOTTOM: left fingertip at the very TIP of the right index finger. The right hand stays flat in both figures.

naam: Kneedgum draaien tussen duim en wijsvinger
pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits at a table, seen from the FRONT. She holds a sausage-shaped roll of therapy putty (about 15 cm long) horizontally in front of her belly, just above the table. Her LEFT hand holds the left end in a closed fist. Her RIGHT hand pinches the right end between the tip of the thumb and the tip of the index finger, the right palm facing DOWN. The arrow is a curved arrow around the right wrist turning OUTWARD (to the viewer's left and up), showing the right forearm rotating so the palm turns up.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The left fist still holds the left end. The right forearm has rotated outward so the right palm now faces UP, the thumb and index finger still pinching the putty, which is visibly twisted.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures close, from the chest up, so the hands and the putty roll are large. TOP: right palm facing DOWN, pinching the end of the roll. BOTTOM: right palm facing UP, the roll clearly twisted like a corkscrew. The shoulders stay level and still.

pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits upright at a table, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view. On the table in front of her stands a plastic cup, with a few wooden clothes-pegs lying next to it. Her right hand holds one clothes-peg pinched OPEN between thumb and index finger, a little above the table beside the pegs. Her shoulders are low. The arrow is a short curved arrow from the peg in her right hand to the RIM of the cup, showing her clipping it on.
eind_en: END position: same view. Several clothes-pegs are clipped around the rim of the cup and her right hand is squeezing one more peg onto the rim. Shoulders still low, trunk still.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures close, from the chest up, the cup and pegs clearly visible. TOP: no pegs on the cup yet, one open peg in the right hand. BOTTOM: five or six pegs clipped around the cup rim, the right hand placing another one.

pose_en: Show only her forearms and hands, seen from the SIDE, with the table edge visible. Her right elbow rests on the table and the right forearm points straight UP, the right fingers straight, palm facing the viewer's left. Her LEFT hand grips the BASE segment of the right index finger (between the knuckle and the middle joint) between thumb and fingers, so the knuckle cannot move. The arrow is a small curved arrow at the right index fingertip going FORWARD and DOWN toward the palm, showing the middle joint bending.
eind_en: END position: same close side view. The left hand still grips the base segment of the right index finger; the middle joint of the right index finger is now bent to about a right angle (the fingertip curls toward the palm), the knuckle stays straight.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures as a close-up of the hands only. Exaggerate the difference: TOP right index finger completely straight, BOTTOM its middle joint bent sharply to 90 degrees while the base segment held by the left hand stays straight.

naam: Opstaan uit de stoel – looprek voor je
pose_en: She sits on the FRONT EDGE of a chair WITH ARMRESTS, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. A walking frame (four-legged walker) stands directly IN FRONT of the chair (on the viewer's right), its handles at hip height. Her feet are flat on the floor, slightly behind her knees. BOTH hands push on the chair ARMRESTS (not on the walker) and her trunk leans forward with a straight back. The arrow is a curved arrow from her hips going FORWARD and UP, showing her standing up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She stands fully upright, hips and knees straight, close behind the walking frame, both hands now holding the walker handles; the chair is behind her.
extra_avatar: The walker stands IN FRONT of her in both figures. TOP: seated on the front edge, hands on the CHAIR armrests, leaning forward. BOTTOM: standing upright, both hands on the walker handles.

naam: Schouderblad naar achteren – zittend met arm op een bal
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a plain chair WITHOUT leaning on the backrest, seen from her RIGHT side at a three-quarter angle (she faces the viewer's right). A large exercise ball stands on the floor directly beside her right hip. Her right arm rests on top of the ball, slightly bent, a little below shoulder height; her left hand rests on her lap. Her right shoulder blade is drawn back and down (shoulder low). The arrow is a straight arrow on top of the ball pointing FORWARD, showing the ball rolling forward under the arm.
eind_en: END position: same view. The ball has rolled forward and her right arm is stretched further forward on top of it; her right shoulder stays low and back and her trunk does not turn or lean.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up. TOP: ball beside her right hip, arm resting on it. BOTTOM: ball clearly rolled forward in front of her, arm reaching forward on it - the shoulder stays low (not shrugged) and the trunk stays upright and facing forward.

naam: Schouderblad sturen – zijlig met arm op een bal
pose_en: She lies on her LEFT side on an exercise mat, seen from the FRONT (her face and chest toward the viewer), head on a pillow, knees bent. A ball (football size) lies on the mat in front of her chest. Her RIGHT arm is straight and rests on top of the ball at shoulder height, reaching forward; her left arm rests under her head. Her right shoulder blade is drawn back. The arrow is a curved arrow along the right arm going UP toward and past the top of her head, showing the ball being rolled upward.
eind_en: END position: same view, lying on her left side. The ball has been rolled up beyond the top of her head and her right arm is stretched straight overhead on the ball; the shoulder blade stays back.
extra_avatar: Only ONE person (no helper). Lying on the left side, seen from the front. TOP: ball in front of the chest, right arm straight forward on it. BOTTOM: ball above the head, right arm straight overhead on it.

naam: Van liggen naar zitten – over de zij uit bed
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on a plain single bed, seen from her LEFT side: the long edge of the bed is nearest to the viewer and she lies along it, head on the viewer's left. Both knees are bent and both feet are flat on the mattress. Her arms lie beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow from her right shoulder rolling over her body TOWARD the viewer and then down over the bed edge, showing her rolling onto her left side toward the edge.
eind_en: END position: she sits upright on the long edge of the bed nearest the viewer, facing the viewer, feet flat on the floor, hands on the mattress beside her hips.
extra_avatar: Show the bed in both figures with its long edge toward the viewer. TOP: lying on her back along the bed, knees bent, feet on the mattress. BOTTOM: sitting on the edge of the bed, feet on the floor, hands beside the hips.

pose_en: Show only her forearms and hands, seen from the SIDE, with the table visible. Her right forearm rests on the table with the THUMB UP (little-finger side down on the table), the right index finger straight. Her LEFT hand grips the right index finger from the knuckle up to just below the last joint, so only the fingertip is free. The arrow is a tiny curved arrow at the fingertip going DOWN toward the palm, showing only the fingertip bending.
eind_en: END position: same close side view. The left hand still grips the right index finger; only the fingertip (last joint) of the right index finger is bent down by about 60 degrees, the rest of the finger stays straight.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures as a close-up of the hands only. Exaggerate the difference: TOP fingertip straight, BOTTOM only the very last joint clearly bent down, the held part of the finger straight.

pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits upright on a chair with a pillow on her lap, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view. Her right arm rests on the pillow, elbow almost straight, right PALM facing UP, fingers relaxed and open. Her left hand holds a small piece of soft fabric and touches it to the TIP of her right index finger. She looks at her fingertip. The arrow is a short straight arrow along the right index finger from the tip toward the palm, showing the fabric stroking down the finger.
eind_en: END position: same view. The fabric has been stroked down the right index finger and now touches the base of that finger near the palm; the right palm still faces up on the pillow.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures close so the upturned right hand and the piece of fabric are large. TOP: fabric on the very tip of the right index finger. BOTTOM: fabric at the base of the same finger.

pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair beside a table; show only her right forearm and hand on the table, seen from the side of the forearm (the thumb side toward the viewer). Her right forearm lies flat on the tabletop, palm facing DOWN, and the hand hangs relaxed DOWN over the edge of the table, the wrist exactly at the edge. The arrow is a curved arrow at the back of the hand going UP, showing the hand being lifted at the wrist.
eind_en: END position: same close view. The forearm still lies flat on the table, palm side down, but the hand is lifted UP at the wrist as far as possible (knuckles pointing up, about 50 degrees above horizontal), fingers relaxed.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP of the right forearm and hand at the table edge, seen from the side. TOP: hand hanging down over the edge. BOTTOM: hand bent UP at the wrist. The forearm stays flat on the table in both figures.

pose_en: She sits upright on the front half of a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, both feet flat on the floor under her knees, hands resting on her thighs. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her shoulders and going FORWARD and UP, showing her leaning forward and standing up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She stands fully UPRIGHT directly in front of the chair, hips and knees straight, arms relaxed beside her body, feet in the same place. The empty chair is right behind her.
